evaluation_policy.question_gold_edits_after_freeze: prohibited; invalid tasks must be logged and excluded without changing frozen file
evaluation_policy.baseline_tools: no retrieval, no Python, no web; same-evidence prompts include only captured agent evidence
evaluation_policy.semantic_adjudication: single-reviewer AI-assisted semantic adjudication, distinct model if accessible
evaluation_policy.numeric_matching: field-specific absolute tolerance from task, units checked separately
evaluation_policy.statistics: paired task bootstrap with 95% percentile intervals; exploratory, not a significance claim
evaluation_policy.scoring_missing_or_blocked: missing output is not imputed as success; report denominator and BLOCKED separately

pre_api_budget.assumptions: One call per task per baseline/track; one separate OpenAI reviewer call per task covering all outputs; plus up to two model-list preflight calls; no automatic content retries. Four clarification tasks may resume the same agent run.
